execution_notes: Local model training and Kaggle execution are strictly forbidden in this task. This configuration specifies the reproducible protocol for Step 7 price-only ML benchmarking.

tier_a.coverage_span_definition: inclusive first-to-last observed trading date within training window

tier_b.coverage_span_definition: inclusive first-to-last observed trading date within training window

features.rolling_window_convention: Preceding calendar span [t-W, t-1] strictly exclusive of t
features.imputation_policy: Training-only fitted median imputer for models requiring dense inputs. Native missing value handling for HistGradientBoosting. Zero future or test imputation leakage.

missing_data_taxonomy.NO_ORIGIN: Series was not observed on candidate calendar origin date t
missing_data_taxonomy.INELIGIBLE_HISTORY: Series failed Tier A (N < 60 or coverage < 0.30) or Tier B (N < 120 or coverage < 0.30) training threshold
missing_data_taxonomy.MISSING_FEATURES: Origin lacks required feature history (e.g. last_observation_age_days is NaN)
missing_data_taxonomy.NO_TARGET: No valid trade observation exists in target evaluation window [t+6, t+8] (evaluation origin skipped)
missing_data_taxonomy.MODEL_ABSTENTION: Model abstains from predicting due to uncertainty, out-of-domain features, or non-finite outputs
missing_data_taxonomy.SERVING_DENIAL: Serving policy denial: market alias under review, unknown grade, or observation older than 3 calendar days

ridge_regression.role: Linear regularized baseline on lagged price and calendar features
ridge_regression.preprocessor: Pipeline([('imputer', SimpleImputer(strategy='median')), ('scaler', StandardScaler())]) fitted strictly on train fold
ridge_regression.tuning_protocol: Inner chronological rolling-origin validation on train fold; zero test fold inspection

hist_gradient_boosting.role: Nonlinear tabular tree baseline with native NaN support
hist_gradient_boosting.tuning_protocol: Inner chronological rolling-origin validation on train fold; zero test fold inspection

paired_skill.formula: 1 - (sum(|y - y_hat|) / sum(|y - y_naive|)) on exactly matched non-abstained finite pairs
paired_skill.confidence_intervals: Cluster bootstrap at series level (95% CI)

slice_stratification: By District (Ghaziabad, Jhansi, Kanpur, Lucknow, Unnao)
By Focus Crop (Potato, Onion, Tomato, Wheat, Rice, Mustard)
